title: docs(spec): related-list descriptions say which unknown names are refused; primary list and trackHistory describe the v3 record page
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJt5Dq32Sbwm4wPh1kLM6ME)_

Fixes #27311
Fixes #27312

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Seat ruling on #27311: option A (by design).** The boundary in `packages/lint/src/validate-related-list-refs.ts`'s header is deliberate: under a package closure a child outside it may be a downstream package's object that points in, which the closure cannot see. Refusing there would refuse legitimate stacks, and option B needs a new declaration surface no card asks for. So the contract text changes to say what is enforced. No change to the lint rule, `defineStack` or the accept set.

**Landing order.** #27312's text describes the record page v3 that PR #27310 builds. #27310 has merged (`eef83734`), and this branch carries it through a merge of `main` at `cf218eed1`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改说明文字。`relatedLists` 和 field group 的 `relatedList` 说清楚哪些未知名称会被拒；`relatedList: 'primary'` 和 `enable.trackHistory` 改成描述 v3 记录页（主表在详情列里，字段变更进时间线，不再有独立页签）。
- 为什么改：旧文字承诺了运行时并不做的拒绝（包内发布会存下未知子对象名），也还在描述 v2 页面的「独立页签」和「History 页签」。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，没有键、类型、默认值或导出变化；回滚即还原文字。按契约复核补了两处精确度：平台前缀名（sys_ / cloud_ / ai_）在 os validate / os build 不判、留给运行时；trackHistory 说明自建页面上 record:history 和 record:activity 两种块都会显示字段变更，且都不读这个开关。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`（relatedLists 的 describe 与 docblock），`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`（relatedList 的 describe），`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`（合成记录页一段）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/record-page-describes.test.ts`，应见 10 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，#27310 已合并，席位落地。

## What changes

Description text only. No key, type, default, accepted value or export moves; `check:api-surface` and `check:authorable-surface` are green with no artifact change.

### #27311: `ObjectSchema.relatedLists` and `fieldGroups[i].relatedList`

Measured on `origin/main` 6d7634a9: `defineStack` (`collectRelatedListNameErrors`, `stack.zod.ts`) refuses a name whose child is declared with no inbound FK, and a name whose child is nowhere (sibling-package and platform objects stay unjudged). The runtime door runs `validateRelatedListRefs`, which refuses a stack child with no inbound FK on every write, and a child missing from the collection only under `wholeCollection` (`reference-integrity-suite.ts`: a gated write with no `packageScope`). A write into a package stores the entry.

Before (`relatedLists` describe):
> An entry that matches no inbound lookup / master_detail field of this object is refused.

After:
> An entry whose child is in the stack but has no inbound lookup / master_detail field to this object is refused everywhere. An entry whose child exists nowhere is refused by os validate / os build (which leave a sys_ / cloud_ / ai_ name to the runtime) and by a metadata write that names no package; a write into a package stores it, since a child outside the package may be a downstream package's object that points here, and the record page places nothing for it.

Before (`fieldGroups[i].relatedList` describe):
> A group with relatedList holds no fields: a field that names it as its group is refused, and so is a name that matches no inbound lookup / master_detail field.

After:
> A group with relatedList holds no fields: a field that names it as its group is refused. The name is judged as a relatedLists entry is: refused when its child is in the stack with no inbound lookup / master_detail field, or exists nowhere (by os validate / os build, which leave a sys_ / cloud_ / ai_ name to the runtime, and by a metadata write that names no package); a write into a package stores it, and the record page places nothing for it.

Both docblocks say the same, and the `relatedLists` one points at the lint rule's header for the reasoning. The platform-prefix clause (r1) is measured at `stack.zod.ts` `collectRelatedListNameErrors`: `if (!fieldsByObject.has(child) && (artifactScope.has(child) || isPlatformObjectName(child))) return;`, where `isPlatformObjectName` is `hasPlatformObjectPrefix` (`PLATFORM_OBJECT_PREFIXES = ['sys_', 'cloud_', 'ai_']`, `platform-object-names.ts`). The runtime door under `wholeCollection` judges such a name against the registry (`validate-related-list-refs.ts`: `if (!fieldsByObject.has(child) && !options?.wholeCollection) return;`).

### #27312: `relatedList: 'primary'` and `enable.trackHistory`

Measured on #27310's head `349cd5625c`:
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` `buildDefaultTabs`: a list with `isBody ?? isPrimary` is a `record:related_list` inside the **Details** tab, placed by `bodyTablePlacement` right after the FIRST field section; every other list is a side card in the one **Related** tab. No per-list tab is emitted. The column tiers (`recordPageColumns.ts`) draw the same Details content in the details column.
- Field changes: `RecordDetailView.tsx` reads `sys_audit_log` only when `enable.trackHistory === true` (`historyEnabled`), and only for the synthesized page; `auditEntriesToFeedItems` turns them into `field_change` items of the one timeline stream (`recordTimelineStream.ts`, filters All / Activity / Discussion / Changes, `streamChanges: 'Changes'` in `en.ts`). No History tab is emitted. On an assigned page `RecordFieldChangesContext` is `null`, and a `record:history` block self-fetches the record's `sys_activity` rows without reading `trackHistory`.

Before (`relatedList` describe, the arms that move):
> true/absent = shown as a supporting list, a side card beside the record (the shared "Related" tab on the tabbed page); 'primary' = part of the record's main content, drawn in the record's body (the details column, after the field sections) as a full-width table (its own tab on the tabbed page).

After:
> true/absent = shown as a supporting list, a side card in the record's related column (the shared "Related" tab on the tabbed page); 'primary' = part of the record's main content, drawn in the record's body (the details column, after its first field section) as a full-width table (inside the Details tab on the tabbed page, with no tab of its own).

Before (`enable.trackHistory` describe):
> Show the record History tab (audit-trail UI). Pair with per-field trackHistory to pick which field diffs are summarized; audit capture itself is always on for compliance

After:
> Show the record's field changes (audit-trail UI): on the default record page they join the record's one timeline stream, under its Changes filter. On an authored page, a record:history or record:activity block shows the record's field changes from its own activity, and neither reads this flag. Pair with per-field trackHistory to pick which field diffs are summarized; audit capture itself is always on for compliance

The order asked for "and the History block on an authored page". Measured on `main`, neither authored block reads `trackHistory`, and neither is the only one that shows changes: `record-history.tsx` self-fetches `sys_activity` and keeps the field-mutating types (`HISTORY_TYPES`), and `record-activity.tsx` self-fetches the same rows and maps `created` / `updated` / `deleted` / `assigned` / `shared` to `field_change` items (`ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE`, `recordActivityFeed.ts`), shown under the Changes filter unless the author writes `unifiedTimeline: false`. On an assigned page `RecordFieldChangesContext` is `null`, so the flag's `sys_audit_log` diffs reach neither block. The text (r2) names both blocks, says neither reads this flag, and claims no exclusivity; r1's "only where it places a record:history block" and its "only as activity lines" docblock parenthetical were wrong and are gone.

### Other sentences the same promises reached

- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, "The synthesized default": the tab strip is now Details / Timeline / Related (plus Approvals), a primary list is a table inside Details, attachments close the Related tab, and the timeline is one stream with the Changes filter. The three-column sentence drops "then Activity and History".
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md` (r1), the wide-layout table: the 1280 px timeline column said "the discussion composer on top, then Activity and History"; on `main` after #27310 it is one stream (`buildDefaultTimeline` emits one `record:activity`), so it now reads "one stream: the composer on top, then the discussion, the activity and, with `enable.trackHistory`, the field changes, filtered by All / Activity / Discussion / Changes". The changeset gains `'@object-ui/plugin-detail': patch` because its `files[]` ships `README.md`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`, row `trackHistory`: the evidence names the timeline stream instead of the History tab (status unchanged, `live`).
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: one `why` string said a `'primary'` switch "promotes the list to its own tab"; it now says "places the list in the record's body".
- Regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: `content/docs/references/{api/metadata,data/field,data/object,system/migration}.mdx`. No translation bundle carries these describes (the Studio form's own `helpText` rows are separate text; see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/data/record-page-describes.test.ts` (10 tests) pins each rewritten describe's load-bearing phrase in the JSON-schema projection, plus the absence of "its own tab" / "History tab" and of the old unbounded refusal sentence.
- Reverse verification: with `object.zod.ts` and `field.zod.ts` restored from `origin/main` 6d7634a9, the file goes red, 10 of 10 (`Test Files 1 failed`, `Tests 10 failed`); restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- r2 moves the `trackHistory` pin to the new sentence and adds two negative pins (`only where it places`, `activity lines`). Reverse leg: with `object.zod.ts` restored from the r1 head `0fae4859d`, exactly that test goes red (`Tests 1 failed | 9 passed`); restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- r1 extends three pins (the platform-prefix clause in both related-list describes, and a `trackHistory` phrase that r2 replaced). Reverse leg: with `object.zod.ts` restored from the r0 head `e4e06533f`, exactly those 3 go red (`Tests 3 failed | 7 passed`); restored from `HEAD`, the tree is clean.
- `@objectstack/spec` on head `456377baa`, under the verify lock: `check:generated --fix` (it regenerated `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`, then all 14 artifacts up to date), then `test` (Test Files 750 passed, Tests 22306 passed, 1 todo) and `typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0. Only `packages/spec` source and one README move, and the public surface is byte-unchanged, so no importer owes a run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Skills (governed, not edited here).** Two published skill sentences still narrate the v2 page and the unbounded refusal: `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` lines 109-110 and 117-121 ("its **own tab** on the tabbed page"; "gets its **own tab**"; "Promoting a child table to a tab"), and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` lines 347-353 ("(its own tab on the tabbed page)"; "a name matching no inbound FK is refused"). `skills/**` is Tier H, so they are left for a governed follow-up (carded as #27354).
- **#27310's own file.** `ui/content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` (on #27310's head) said "one tab per related list flagged `relatedList: 'primary'`" and "→ **History**". It no longer exists on `main` (retired by #27329), so nothing is owed.
- **Studio form help.** `object.form.ts`'s `relatedLists` help ("saving or validating the object refuses it") is shown only in Studio, whose pre-write check (PR #27303, merged) refuses such a name, so it is true for its reader and stays.
- Hand-written `content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx` also said "History tab"; #27310 rewrites that line, so it is not touched here.
